prompt.task_description: Assess the earnings quality of ALB for the period ending 2024-09-30 using its 10-Q filing and structured financial data. Compute the Piotroski F-Score (9 binary components covering profitability, leverage, and efficiency), the Beneish M-Score (8 variable model for earnings manipulation detection), the accruals ratio, and the income quality ratio. Flag any material concerns (low Piotroski score ≤ 3, Beneish M-Score > −1.78, high accruals > 10%, or negative income quality). Use only data available as of 2024-11-06.
prompt.output_instructions: Respond with a JSON object containing: piotroski_score (int 0–9), piotroski_components (object with 9 boolean fields), beneish_m_score (float), beneish_flag (boolean), accruals_ratio (float), income_quality_ratio (float), and flags (array of string flag names).
